100.$description: Used by: light bg.page (Sampled), light surface.button (Sampled), light surface.gutter (Sampled).

card.$description: Grouped cards (Home, Explore, Settings, Code Options): 25.6pt on Home in both themes, 25.6pt in Settings, 25.6pt on the code preview. Plus or minus 2 pt.

button.$description: Full-width and paired buttons (Add Favorites, Star): 13.7pt dark and 15.4pt light on Add Favorites, 15.4pt and 11.9pt on Star. Plus or minus 2 pt.

status.$description: The profile status card: 11.9pt in both themes.

tile.$description: Coloured icon tiles in rows: 6.8pt on a 32 pt tile.

branch.$description: Branch-name pills ('main'): the 1 px rim turns its corner over about 6 px (3 pt) in dark/05 and light/05; read from the pixels, not with diag, because the rim stops the diagonal walk.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: filter chips, state badges (Open, Draft, Merged, Locked), issue labels, status chips, the New badge, switches, the tab bar and its selected pill, glass nav buttons, the search field and the floating New Session button.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two, except the 13 to 14 pt title gap.

xs.$description: Gap between a state badge and the next badge or pill.

sm.$description: Gap between filter chips (8 to 9 pt in 03 and 13).

md.$description: Gap between an icon tile and its row title (12 pt: tile ends at 76 pt, text starts at 88 pt in 01).

lg.$description: Screen margin: cards, section titles and full-bleed list text start 16 pt from the screen edge (x 48 px in every capture).

xl.$description: Padding inside a grouped card: the icon tile and settings row text start 20 pt from the card's edge.

titleGap.$description: From a section title's baseline area to its card: 13.5 pt from the cap bottom of 'My Work' to the card in 01, 13 pt for 'Favorites'.

sectionGap.$description: From a card's bottom to the next section title's cap top: 37 pt in 01 (card ends at y 713, 'Favorites' caps start at 787).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, titles and list rows.

row.$description: Grouped row with an icon tile (Home My Work, Explore, repository, profile) and search scope rows, divider to divider: dividers at 482 and 596 px in 01.

rowSettings.$description: Settings row without a tile: dividers 106 to 107 px apart in 21 (452, 558, 665, 774, 881).

navButton.$description: Round glass back, close and more buttons: 44pt wide dark, 46pt light, 45pt tall, the glass rim's soft edge included.

height.$description: Floating glass tab bar (Home, Inbox, Explore, Copilot).

width.$description: Tab bar width, inset from the screen edges.

searchField.$description: Search field (glass capsule) at the top of search.

chip.$description: Filter chip height: 28.5pt dark, 29.5pt light, glass rim included.

button.$description: Full-width and paired buttons (Add Favorites 326x44pt, Star 246x44pt).

iconButton.$description: Square icon button beside Star (fork, watch): 44x44pt.

buttonCompact.$description: Inline buttons in a card: Copilot's 'Email me a download link' (199x34pt), Configure (94x34.5pt).

fab.$description: Floating New Session button (146x41pt in light, where its ink fill gives a clean edge).

newBadge.$description: The 'New' badge before a settings row: 31x21.5pt.

tile.$description: Coloured icon tile in a row: 32x32pt dark, 31x31pt light.

header.$description: Account avatar at the top left of Home: 41pt, anti-aliased edge included.

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, icon buttons, rows and full buttons are 44 pt or more. Chips (29 pt), badges and the compact buttons (34 pt) are smaller.

hairline.$description: Dividers between rows and between list sections: one device pixel at 2x, anti-aliased over two rows.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms are close to the iOS system face; use the platform font.

mono.$description: Code, diffs, branch names and search qualifiers use a monospace face. Not determinable from pixels; use the platform monospace.

regular.$description: Body text, row titles, settings rows, meta lines. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Badge and chip labels, tab labels. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Nav titles, button labels, empty-state titles. Judged by stroke width.

bold.$description: The large title, section titles, issue and repository titles, grouped section headers. Judged by stroke width.

largeTitle.$description: Tab root titles (Inbox, Explore, Copilot). Cap-height readings: 34pt.

title.$description: Issue and PR titles, Home and Explore section titles, empty-state lines (semibold there). Cap-height readings: 22pt.

headline.$description: Nav titles and button labels. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Comment and Markdown body text, Settings rows. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

rowTitle.$description: Titles of rows in a grouped card (Issues, Top Repositories) and the row age. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

callout.$description: Inbox, issue and PR row titles, result owner lines, banner text (on the same 20 pt line). Cap-height readings: 15pt.

sectionHeader.$description: Grey grouped section headers on Code Options (Preview, Display, Editing). Cap-height readings: 16pt.

caption.$description: Filter chip and state badge labels. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

footnote.$description: Author role labels (Member, Contributor). Cap-height readings: 11pt.

code.$description: Diff code, one row per line; the code preview runs on a 20px line. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (nav buttons, the tab bar, the search field, filter chips, menus, the dark New Session button): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: none drawn; separation comes from the page and card fills and the glass material
Issue and PR label colours: each repository sets its own, so they are data, not tokens
Line heights of one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured

page.$description: Page behind grouped cards: Home, Explore, Copilot, Settings, Appearance, the Filters sheet.

list.$description: Full-bleed list and detail pages: Inbox, search scopes, Issues, Pull Requests, the repository, issue and PR pages. The same value as surface.card.

grouped.$description: Code Options, a system grouped table: the iOS grouped background, not the GitHub page colour.

card.$description: Grouped cards, list rows and the code preview. Settings cards read #FFFFFF, Code Options cells #FFFFFF.

button.$description: Neutral buttons (Add Favorites, Get started, Star, fork and watch; Star reads #F6F8FA).

muted.$description: Muted fills: the Locked badge, agent-session status chips (#EFF1F3) and the profile status card (#F1F1F3).

glass.$description: Glass controls (tab bar, nav buttons, search field, filter chips) over an empty page; nav buttons read #F8FAFC. The material tints with what is behind it.

tabSelected.$description: The selected tab's pill inside the tab bar.

menu.$description: Pull-down and pop-up menus (glass; the reading picks up the page behind). Not captured in light: filled from surface.glass, the closest light role.

fab.$description: Floating New Session button: grey glass in dark, the theme's ink in light.

gutter.$description: Line-number gutter of unchanged diff lines.

divider.$description: Hairline between rows in a card or list, inset to the row text.

section.$description: Full-width hairline between list sections (under the Inbox chips, around the notification banner).

primary.$description: Titles, row titles, body text, button labels on neutral buttons.

secondary.$description: Meta lines (repository and number), row values, ages, empty-state bodies, line numbers. Readings in this role: #5B626C, #5B626D, #616772.

sectionHeader.$description: Grouped section headers on Code Options: the system grey, not GitHub's.

placeholder.$description: Search field placeholder. Not captured in light: filled from text.secondary, the closest light role.

link.$description: Links and text buttons (View All, Configure reads #0169DA, hunk headers #0169DA).

onEmphasis.$description: Labels on filled badges and buttons (Merged, Draft, Open, the purple Copilot button #FFFFFF, New Session #FFFFFF).

tabSelected.$description: Selected tab label and icon: the accent.

fg.$description: Unread dots, the Appearance tick, the search caret and links. The box's dominant colour covers 68% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

emphasis.$description: Switch on: in dark the same blue as accent.fg.

subtle.$description: Tinted fills behind accent text: Configure, the New badge, unread counts, branch-name pills (#DEF4FE), hunk headers (#DEF4FE). The box's dominant colour covers 89% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

caret.$description: Text caret in a focused field: the only focus indicator (no ring). A one-pixel column, so the share is low. Not captured in light: filled from accent.fg, the closest light role (the caret blinked off in light/08).

fg.$description: Additions in a diffstat, open-issue and open-PR icons.

emphasis.$description: The Open state badge, white label. Not captured in light: filled from tile.green, the Issues tile, the closest light green.

fg.$description: Deletions in a diffstat and failure icons (the Failed agent-session icon reads #D0222D). No red fill was seen.

subtle.$description: The Archived banner under a repository's nav bar.

fg.$description: Purple text buttons (Dismiss on the Copilot card).

button.$description: The filled purple Copilot button ('Email me a download link').

emphasis.$description: The Draft state badge, white label.

hunk.$description: Hunk header row; its text is text.link.

green.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Issues. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box.

gray.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Top Repositories, Repositories. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 84% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

yellow.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Starred. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box.

blue.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Pull Requests. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 77% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

purple.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Discussions, Trending Repositories. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 64% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

gold.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Actions. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 83% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

pink.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Agents. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 84% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

red.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Awesome Lists. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 89% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

orange.$description: Icon tile behind a white glyph: Organizations. A Derived reading means the glyph covers part of the box. The box's dominant colour covers 81% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

success.$description: Success: green text and icons; the Open badge fills with success.emphasis.

done.$description: Done: GitHub's purple for merged and completed.

notTokenised: Danger fill: no red badge, button or banner was seen
Issue and PR label colours: set per repository
